scenes.text: They're one meter from your food. And they're still digging.
You locked this family out of your bunker. Now they're tunneling in.
So you build a steel wall. Plate, after plate.
Thick steel. A shovel can't get through this.
Bolt it, and brace it, so it can't be pushed in.
For the first time in days, you actually sleep.
An hour later, the air vent goes quiet.
Three of them. Sitting on your air vent. Blocking it.
No fresh air. And the carbon dioxide starts climbing.
Your head starts pounding. That's the first sign.
Then, a note falls out of the vent.
Open the hatch. Or no air.
Do you open it? Or do you risk it? Top comment decides part five.
